description.html: HabiStat Repton 100g in a jar is a larger pack of the popular vitamin, mineral and amino acid supplement for insect-eating reptiles. It has the same formula as Repton in the 40g pouch, but in a practical jar that is easier to store and use over a longer period. The wide-mouth jar makes it easy to dust insects without spilling, and the sturdy lid keeps the supplement fresh and protected from moisture.

Repton contains vitamin A, the complete B-complex, vitamins C, D3, E and K3, a wide range of minerals and essential amino acids. This comprehensive formula ensures that insect-eating reptiles such as leopard geckos, bearded dragons, chameleons and similar species get all the micronutrients they need from their insect diet. The ultra-fine grain sticks evenly to insects, which guarantees a consistent dose of nutrients at every meal.

The 100g pack is a more economical choice for owners who keep several reptiles or who want a longer-lasting supply of supplement. The recommended dosing stays the same as with the smaller pack - dusting insects at every eighth feeding. This pack is especially practical for breeders and owners of larger reptile collections who need a larger amount of supplement.
